name: FPHB
recent: FPHB 在 2026 年 11 月 19 日公布了截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的季度业绩。此前，公司于 10 月宣布每股 0.6 仙的单层中期股息，除息日为 10 月 16 日，派发日为 11 月 11 日。此外，公司董事及主要股东在 9 月至 11 月期间多次在公开市场增持股份。
notable: 宣布每股 0.6 仙的单层中期股息，除息日为 2026 年 10 月 16 日，派发日为 2026 年 11 月 11 日。
董事及主要股东在 2026 年 9 月至 11 月期间多次在公开市场增持公司股份。
因行使凭单 A 发行 10,000 股新股，发行价为每股 RM0.40，新股于 2026 年 10 月 14 日上市。
risks: 与关联方 Nam Kee Impex Pte. Ltd. 的经常性关联交易在 2026 年 6 月 7 日至 9 月 30 日期间的累计交易金额超过公司净资产 1%。

events.what_en: Listing of new shares from warrant exercise

recent_en: FPHB announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 19 November 2026. Earlier, the company declared a single-tier interim dividend of 0.6 sen per share, with ex-date on 16 October and payment date on 11 November. In addition, directors and substantial shareholders have repeatedly acquired shares in the open market between September and November.
notable_en: Declared a single-tier interim dividend of 0.6 sen per share, with ex-date on 16 October 2026 and payment date on 11 November 2026.
Directors and substantial shareholders acquired shares in the open market multiple times between September and November 2026.
Issued 10,000 new shares upon exercise of Warrants A at an issue price of RM0.40 per share, listed on 14 October 2026.
risks_en: The cumulative recurrent related party transactions with Nam Kee Impex Pte. Ltd. from 7 June 2026 to 30 September 2026 exceeded 1% of the company's net assets.
